quirks.summary: The LBH skin emits `href ="viewDocument?..."` with a space before the `=`, so a grep anchored on `href="` finds zero document links and reports a clean run.
quirks.detail: The page is fine; only the attribute spacing is non-canonical.
quirks.workaround: Match the endpoint name (viewDocument\?file=) or allow whitespace with `href *=`.

quirks.summary: The whole chain is stateless - not one cookie is ever set, not even a passive fingerprint script.

quirks.detail: Long references are truncated by the form rather than rejected.

quirks.summary: showDocuments is sectioned by category, with per-row dd-mm-yy dates and descriptions - use them to label the files.
Hillingdon's historic 'bespoke portal' reputation is stale - this is stock Ocella under a heavy skin, and PlanIt's scraper_type Ocella is correct.

cohort_scope.note: The same OcellaWeb instance serves the appeals, building control and enforcement registers alongside planning, so a record found on this host is not necessarily a planning application.

source_notes: STOCK OCELLA under a heavy LBH skin (the historic 'bespoke portal' reputation is stale; PlanIt scraper_type Ocella is correct). Recipe E verbatim, base /OcellaWeb (no path prefix). WHOLE CHAIN STATELESS — zero cookies ever set (not even passive fingerprint scripts; cleanest portal tested). CRITICAL GREP QUIRK: the skin emits `href ="viewDocument?..."` (space before =) — grep viewDocument\?file= (or href *=), else silent zero links. Ref format NNNNN/APP/YYYY/NNNN (leading site id). Search field maxlength=20. showDocuments page is sectioned by category with per-row dd-mm-yy dates + descriptions for labelling. PlanIt url = planningDetails deep link AND other_fields.docs_url = showDocuments link — both steps skippable. Same OcellaWeb instance serves appeals/bc/enforcement modules (module=pl is planning).

verification.note: Recipe E ran verbatim against the skinned install; document links enumerated once the grep was widened past the non-canonical `href =` spacing.
